<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_TicketBooking"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingRequest" name="Booking request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PreTravelReminder" name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking" name="Ticket booking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BookingRequest"
                      name="Booking request"
                      sourceRef="Task_SubmitBookingDetails"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_BookingRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_BookingRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket"
                      name="Ticket"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendTicket"
                      targetRef="CatchEvent_TicketReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PreTravelReminder"
                      name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendReminder"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_PreTravelReminder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Search" name="Search for a ticket"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Search" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRoute" name="Select preferred route, date, and time"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitBookingDetails" name="Submit booking details" messageRef="Message_BookingRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_TicketReceived" name="Receive ticket">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_TicketReceived" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravelChoice" name="Post-travel feedback or services?" default="Flow_Customer_NoPostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide post-travel feedback"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UsePostTravelServices" name="Use post-travel services"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_JourneyComplete" name="Journey complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PostTravelComplete" name="Post-travel activity complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Search" targetRef="Task_Search"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_Search" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_ProvideDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Task_SubmitBookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_SubmitBookingDetails" targetRef="CatchEvent_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="CatchEvent_TicketReceived" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravelChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_NoPostTravel" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelChoice" targetRef="EndEvent_JourneyComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelChoice" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer chooses to provide post-travel feedback</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Services" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelChoice" targetRef="Task_UsePostTravelServices">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer chooses to use post-travel services</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_FeedbackEnd" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_PostTravelComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_ServicesEnd" sourceRef="Task_UsePostTravelServices" targetRef="EndEvent_PostTravelComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel company booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_TravelCompany">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BookingSystem" name="Booking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_BookingRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CompanyParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CompanyParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_CompanyComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_TravelCompany" name="Travel company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BookingRequest" name="Booking request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BookingRequest" messageRef="Message_BookingRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyParallelSplit" name="Send ticket and update inventory"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket via email or SMS" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyParallelJoin" name="Ticket sent and inventory updated"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderChoice" name="Send pre-travel reminders?" default="Flow_ReminderSkip"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Message_PreTravelReminder"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderMerge" name="Continue after reminder decision"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CompanyComplete" name="Booking support complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_BookingRequest" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_3" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_4" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_5" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_6" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_7" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyParallelJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderSend" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice" targetRef="Task_SendReminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A pre-travel reminder is to be sent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderSkip" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderDone" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_8" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_CompanyComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
